steps.step: policy setup and verification on all three instances (probes)
idle 6 s: pending statistics flushes complete
Redis reset: FLUSHDB + CONFIG RESETSTAT + SLOWLOG RESET on the verified container
idle 11 s: Prometheus scrapes the idle state
snapshots before the run (raw counters, Prometheus, Redis)
cooldown 12 s: final Prometheus scrape (2 × 5 s) and final statistics flush (5 s)
collect: Prometheus measure window, Nginx, docker stats
